successors.name: Avanti
successors.text: 'Later, the Vatsa kingdom was annexed by the Avanti kingdom'; Maniprabha, a great-grandson of Pradyota, ruled at Kausambi as an Avanti prince

ledger.x: 600 BCE: Vatsa enters the map as one of the sixteen Mahajanapadas, with Kausambi as capital.

certainty.note: The Ganga bounds the country on the north, but no frontier with Kosala, Kasi, Cedi or Avanti is given.
